title: ValidationArtifact
description: Agreement statistics between two uncertain estimates, for one regime. Neither source is ground truth: these are limits of agreement between measurement methods, not errors against a reference. See docs/04-methodology.md.

regime.description: The stratum this artifact applies to. Strata are declared a priori; see docs/04-methodology.md.

criteria.description: Machine-readable definition of the stratum, e.g. airframe_type, has_airspeed_sensor, variance band, altitude band, terrain class, season.

sources_compared.description: e.g. ["era5_wind", "px4_ekf2_wind"] or a three-way comparison including a METAR station.

bias.description: Mean difference between the two estimates, in the stated unit.

limits_of_agreement.description: Lower and upper limits of agreement.

bootstrap.description: Bootstrap is by run, never by window: windows within a run are not independent and treating them as such inflates precision.

useful_proxy.description: Whether the reanalysis is a useful proxy in this regime, against a threshold stated in the manifest. False is a publishable result.

manifest_id.description: The AnalysisManifest that produced these statistics. No result without a manifest.
